title: Archive digitization deadline
frame: A local museum is digitizing 4,000 catalog folders before a public exhibition in ten weeks. Scanning is ahead of plan, but metadata review and rights checks have accumulated a backlog. Folders vary greatly in size and completeness, and volunteers work different days. The project lead needs to decide the next two weeks of assignments and whether to revise the promised exhibition scope, using daily counts and a limited sample of folder histories.
